semantic_protocol.note: This is a sampled diagnostic, not full-corpus semantic deduplication. Similarity clusters can include different articles about the same event.

availability.publisher_holdout: Not measured: original CSVs have no authenticated publisher identifiers.
availability.independent_dataset: Not measured: an independent licensed evaluation dataset is required.
availability.semantic_deduplication: Sampled diagnostic measured on 500 articles; not full-corpus deduplication.

protocol: Each experiment retrains both algorithms. TF-IDF fits training only; calibration uses its separate partition. Production weights are unchanged. Temporal boundaries use dates only, with later repeated headline groups removed. Lexical overlap screening uses train-fitted TF-IDF and a predeclared cosine threshold of 0.85.
limits: These experiments remain within the historical source corpus; they are not current-news accuracy estimates.
Lexical cosine screening is not semantic deduplication.
Removing four selected source cues does not remove all publisher/style signals.
Wording substitutions are deterministic lexical stress tests, not a human-validated paraphrase benchmark.
Headline-only results are stress tests; the production app abstains on short input.
Coverage here uses the model-score threshold only, not all application abstention rules.
Claim selection is heuristic. Evidence relation models, Hindi extraction, OCR and ASR have not received domain-level accuracy evaluation.
